description: OriDB v3.0 trial release: the Confirmed origin tier only, carried forward from OriDB v2 with explicit evidence records.
inclusion_rule: An origin is Confirmed if its interval overlaps at least one plasmid (ARS) assay positive or one 2D gel electrophoresis record.

sacCer1.note: Coordinates are as stored in OriDB v2 and verified sacCer1 by sequence anchoring. Lift-over to sacCer3 is NOT yet applied.

provenance.source: nieduszy_oridb MySQL dump (OriDB v2.1.0 cerevisiae / v1.0.0 pombe)

known_issues: Non-Confirmed v2 origins that overlap direct evidence and need curator review: sc_ori 79 (Dubious), sc_ori 84 (Dubious), sc_ori 741 (Likely).
24 evidence records carry no PubMed ID in v2 and need a citation assigned.
Cerevisiae coordinates are sacCer1 (2003). External links therefore use db=sacCer1, not sacCer3.
